name: language-select
title: Language select
description: Languages named in themselves and in your language, searchable by either name, with a short list of suggestions pinned on top.
docs: Only codes go in (languages, suggested) and one code comes out; there is no data to ship, because the names come from Intl.DisplayNames in the browser: the language in itself, large, and in locale, quietly beside it. The search ignores capitals and accents and reads the native name, the translated name, the code and the names in each locale of alsoSearch, so 'ger', 'deut' and, with alsoSearch={['en', 'fr']}, 'allem' all find German. A right-to-left name keeps its own direction inside the row while the layout stays left to right, every name carries lang so Chinese and Japanese get their own letterforms, and variants (pt-BR) sort next to their language. messages replaces the headings and the other words, so they can follow locale.
